mapper.select: SELECT LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm FROM web_link_sys_info WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY (SELECT sort_seq FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.link_sys_cd=web_link_sys_info.LINK_SYS_CD), LINK_SYS_NM
SELECT STN_CD AS stnCd, STN_NM AS stnNm FROM com_stn_info WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY STN_SEQ

SELECT MIN(D.event_seq) AS dsbltyTypeSn, D.event_type AS evntCd, D.event_type AS dsbltyTypeNm, (SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=D.ems_id) AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, CASE MIN(CAST(D.event_grade AS UNSIGNED)) WHEN 1 THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN 2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN 3 THEN 'LOW' WHEN 4 THEN 'WARNING' WHEN 5 THEN 'INFO' END AS bscGrdCd, MIN(D.event_grade) AS bscGrdNm, '게이트웨이 raw_event_log 수신값' AS jgmtCrtrCn, 'N' AS autoEndYn, 'N' AS smsUseYn, 'Y' AS autoRegYn, 'Y' AS useYn, MAX(D.reg_dt) AS mdfcnDt FROM raw_event_log D LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=((SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=D.ems_id)) WHERE D.ems_id IN #{id} AND D.ems_id=((SELECT SM.ems_id FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.link_sys_cd=#{linkSysCd})) AND D.event_grade=(CASE #{grade} WHEN 'EMERGENCY' THEN '1' WHEN 'HIGH' THEN '2' WHEN 'LOW' THEN '3' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN '4' WHEN 'INFO' THEN '5' ELSE #{grade} END) AND (D.event_type LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR D.event_msg LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) GROUP BY D.ems_id,D.event_type,L.LINK_SYS_NM ORDER BY D.ems_id,D.event_type LIMIT 500

SELECT D.event_seq AS dsbltyTypeSn, D.event_type AS evntCd, D.event_type AS dsbltyTypeNm,D.event_msg AS dsbltyNm, D.event_loc AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm,D.event_dt AS regDt,D.reg_dt AS mdfcnDt, CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' END AS bscGrdCd, D.event_grade AS bscGrdNm, (SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=D.ems_id) AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm FROM raw_event_log D LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=((SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=D.ems_id)) WHERE D.event_seq=#{eventSeq} AND D.ems_id IN #{id}

SELECT G.EXCP_GROUP_SN AS groupSn,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM AS groupNm,G.EXCP_GROUP_EXPLN AS groupExpln,G.USE_YN AS useYn, COUNT(R.DEVICE_ID) AS memberCount FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_info G LEFT JOIN web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel R ON R.EXCP_GROUP_SN=G.EXCP_GROUP_SN GROUP BY G.EXCP_GROUP_SN,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM,G.EXCP_GROUP_EXPLN,G.USE_YN ORDER BY G.USE_YN DESC,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM

SELECT EXCP_GROUP_SN AS groupSn,EXCP_GROUP_NM AS groupNm,EXCP_GROUP_EXPLN AS groupExpln,USE_YN AS useYn,REG_DT AS regDt,MDFCN_DT AS mdfcnDt FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_info WHERE EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{_parameter}

SELECT CONCAT(R.EMS_ID,':',R.DEVICE_ID) AS eqpmntSn,R.EMS_ID AS emsId,R.DEVICE_ID AS gatewayDeviceId, COALESCE(E.device_nm,R.DEVICE_ID) AS eqpmntNm,R.DEVICE_ID AS eqpmntMngNo, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,S.STN_NM AS stnNm,R.ALL_IDCT_YN AS allIdctYn, E.device_ip AS ipAddr FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel R LEFT JOIN com_device_info E ON E.ems_id=R.EMS_ID AND E.device_id=R.DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=(SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=R.EMS_ID) LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.stn_cd WHERE R.EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{_parameter} ORDER BY COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ,999),L.LINK_SYS_NM,eqpmntNm

SELECT CONCAT(E.ems_id,':',E.device_id) AS eqpmntSn,E.ems_id AS emsId, E.device_id AS gatewayDeviceId,E.device_nm AS eqpmntNm,E.device_id AS eqpmntMngNo, (SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=E.ems_id) AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,E.stn_cd AS stnCd,S.STN_NM AS stnNm,E.device_ip AS ipAddr, CASE E.ping_alive WHEN 1 THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN -1 THEN 'OFFLINE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS sttsCd FROM com_device_info E LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=(SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=E.ems_id) LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.stn_cd WHERE E.use_yn='Y' AND E.ems_id=(SELECT SM.ems_id FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.link_sys_cd=#{linkSysCd}) AND E.stn_cd=#{stnCd} AND (E.device_nm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR E.device_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ,999),E.ems_id,E.device_nm LIMIT 1000
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel WHERE EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{_parameter} AND 1=0
DELETE R FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R JOIN web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info S ON S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN WHERE S.EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{_parameter}
mapper.select: SELECT S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AS scheduleSn, S.EXCP_GROUP_SN AS groupSn, G.EXCP_GROUP_NM AS groupNm, S.EXCP_SCHDL_NM AS scheduleNm, S.BGNG_DT AS bgngDt, S.END_DT AS endDt, S.REPT_CYCLE_CN AS reptCycleCn, S.EXCP_RSN AS excpRsn, S.USE_YN AS useYn, S.NO_END_YN AS noEndYn, TIME_FORMAT(S.REPT_START_TM, '%H:%i') AS startTime, TIME_FORMAT(S.REPT_END_TM, '%H:%i') AS endTime, CASE WHEN S.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' THEN 'REPEAT' ELSE 'ONCE' END AS runType, CASE WHEN S.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(S.REPT_CYCLE_CN,'|',2),'|',-1) ELSE NULL END AS repeatCycle, CASE WHEN S.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(S.REPT_CYCLE_CN,'|',-1) ELSE NULL END AS repeatDays, S.REG_DT AS regDt, S.MDFCN_DT AS mdfcnDt FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info S JOIN web_dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=S.EXCP_GROUP_SN WHERE S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=#{_parameter}
SELECT DSBLTY_GRD_CD FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel WHERE EXCP_SCHDL_SN=#{_parameter} ORDER BY FIELD(DSBLTY_GRD_CD,'EMERGENCY','HIGH','LOW','WARNING','INFO')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info (EXCP_GROUP_SN, EXCP_SCHDL_NM, BGNG_DT, END_DT, NO_END_YN, REPT_START_TM, REPT_END_TM, REPT_CYCLE_CN, EXCP_RSN, USE_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{groupSn}, #{scheduleNm}, #{bgngDt}, #{endDt}, #{noEndYn}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{reptCycleCn}, #{excpRsn}, #{useYn}, NOW(), #{rgtrId})
mapper.update: UPDATE web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info SET EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{groupSn}, EXCP_SCHDL_NM=#{scheduleNm}, BGNG_DT=#{bgngDt}, END_DT=#{endDt}, NO_END_YN=#{noEndYn}, REPT_START_TM=#{startTime}, REPT_END_TM=#{endTime}, REPT_CYCLE_CN=#{reptCycleCn}, EXCP_RSN=#{excpRsn}, USE_YN=#{useYn}, MDFCN_DT=NOW(), MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE EXCP_SCHDL_SN=#{scheduleSn}
